mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 40 degrees under clear skies at Harriet Park. We have a Waning Gibbous moon and an exciting sight as the International Space Station passes overhead at 6:40 AM, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the southeast near Oregon.

City updates this morning: Winter street parking rules go into effect from November 20 through April 1, requiring alternate-side parking from 1:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. to assist with snow removal. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving.

We have plenty to do, starting with the Main Street Trick-or-Treat and live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the Dane County Farmers' Market and live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was arrested for O W I, first offence.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
